task: RGB-only flooded-road segmentation with fixed SEG prefix
selection: Official train: all 162 positives + SHA256-ordered 138 negatives; official val: 30 positives + 50 negatives; official test: all 448 images. Fixed before inference.
checkpoint_selection: Best of three fixed uniform soups on original 80-image validation set; evaluate selected soup on full test and holdout even if it loses to the best individual checkpoint.
training_sampling: 50% positive, 50% negative, replacement; shared seed gives same sample/augmentation sequence for head and first LoRA arm
scope: Inference only; uniform arithmetic averages of compatible decoder and projection parameters across fixed seeds. No independent averaging of LoRA factors.

loss_formula.long_bce_lovasz: BCE + binary Lovasz hinge, valid pixels, per image

averaging: Uniform average of training states at steps 3200,4000,4800. Compare to best single state using validation IoU only; identical treatment for both arms.
test_access: After all scheduled training (or deadline stop), each selected model is evaluated once on all 448 test images. Do not branch on test metrics.
original_scope: Model-soups inspired uniform parameter averaging; same frozen backbone and base initialization across all members.
